title: rules.version.withdrawn.v1
description: Written to the Rule Engine outbox in the transaction where the requester of a publication withdraws it (POST .../versions/{v}:withdraw, PD-089, RLE-046). The version is a DRAFT again; nothing was published and the version in effect did not change. The outbox row id is the event id. Additive changes only within v1 (DESIGN section 3.3).

version.description: Version number of the rule set, not the lock version.

tenantId.description: The tenant, from the authenticated context; never from a request body.

actor.description: Who sent the command; always equal to withdrawnBy.

occurredAt.description: When the withdrawal committed, ISO 8601 UTC.

withdrawnBy.description: The requester who took the request back.

reason.description: The reason given, or null when none was given. At most lifecycle.reason-max-length characters.
